notes.title: Axe Ghost 1.1 - Fragments Update
notes.notes:
Axe Ghost 1.1 adds Fragments mode; A collection of 21 puzzles created by Richard Boeser (ibb & obb, Dubio). You get one hand of cards, and a starting pattern of monsters that needs rearranging to achieve the objective. Complete the Fragments in any order you like. They start off gentle but get pretty challenging. I've forgotten how to complete Curtains. See if you can figure it out! 

Oh yeah: If you’ve played Axe Ghost, consider leaving a review (positive or negative). It's currently sitting at seven reviews from buyers. If it gets to ten that helps bring it to the attention of others who'd enjoy it! notes.title: Update. June 10.
notes.notes:
Changed: Removed 'one undo' limit from the Daily Challenge.
Changed: On game over the leaderboard scroll is set to shows the players entry.
Fixed: Bug where some score charts wouldn't reflect your latest run if you beat your prior score in the daily.
Fixed: Score charts at the bottom of the list no longer cut off by the edge of the game window.

notes.title: Update. June 8.
notes.notes:
Added: Tooltips for bosses clarifying the effect of using the Skull Axe on them (game over or win).
Fixed: 'Lorem Ipsum' bug on messages tab.
Fixed: Leaderboard touch scrolling works on Steam Deck again.
Fixed: Leaderboard icon tooltips now working on run end screen.

notes.title: Hotfix 3. June 4.
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the training progress would get screwy if edited via the settings screen.

notes.title: Hotfix 2. June 4.
notes.notes: Fixed: Certain in-game announcements weren't showing up under certain conditions.

notes.title: Hotfix. June 4.
notes.notes:
Fixes a bug where the Path to Readiness training stages wouldn't show up after completing the tutorial. If you played yesterday and didn't see Path to Readiness training stages you can use the Training slider on the settings page to play them.

This update also adds various tooltips.

notes.title: Update notes. June 3.
notes.notes:
Changed the Timer description to clarify that you can continue your run after the timer reaches zero. Ignore the timer while you're getting used to the game!

Scalpel mechanic has been simplified. See description in-game.

Coin cooldown removed; you can use multiple coins in the same turn.

notes.title: Recent Changes #2
notes.notes:
Added

 Tusskra is the new boss of the first three Path to Readiness levels.
 Path to Readiness progress can be modified via the Settings screen.
 Box weapon.


Fixed

 Quests sometimes got interrupted by Routs.
 Daily run score submission retries up to ten times if there's a failure.
 Fixed: Played coins would interfere with quest completion.


Changed

 Switch weapon can now be used to swap Bosses with isolated monsters.
 Rout cooldown removed. Routs can now be caused on consecutive turns.
 Higher master audio level is possible in settings.
 Lots of graphics changes.

notes.title: Recent changes #1
notes.notes:
Added

 Two new environments.
 Tutorial improvements.
 Path to Readiness for more gentle progression.


Fixed

 Grid bug in cave environment.
 Quest trigger bug.
 Tutorial advance bug.
 Bug where quickly abandoning a new game would mess things up.
 Coin number label bug.
 Coin remained grey bug.
 Spam 'End turn' button after killing boss bug.


Changed

 Less waiting around during Rout animations.
 Hovering over enemies with the Axe shows an indicator if a rout will happen.
 And a rout immediately ends the turn.
 Cards discarded because of a rout do not trigger quest failure.
 You can select the next weapon while the previous attack is still playing.
